title: A first week in Vietnam
summary: Hanoi, a Ha Long day boat, Hue, and Hoi An. Out of Da Nang.

days.title: Day 1 — Old Quarter
days.body: Land in Hanoi and walk the Old Quarter.

days.title: Day 2 — Lake and citadel
days.body: Walk Hoan Kiem Lake and the citadel.

days.title: Day 3 — Ha Long
days.body: Take a day boat. Route 2 clocks Ti Top, Sung Sot, and Luon at 5–6 hours.

days.title: Day 5 — Hue Citadel
days.body: Visit the citadel on the 200,000 VND adult ticket.

days.title: Day 6 — Hoi An
days.body: Travel to Hoi An and walk from the Japanese Covered Bridge.

days.title: Day 7 — Leave Da Nang
days.body: Keep the morning in Hoi An and leave from Da Nang.

seoDescription: Hanoi, a Ha Long day boat, Hue, and Hoi An in seven days, out of Da Nang.
